verdict.rationale: Mailgun's pricing page lists "100 emails per day included", and its quickstart lets you send right away from a sandbox domain. A community user reports running their SaaS emails on Mailgun for years "without paying a cent", which suggests real deliveries are possible without paying. However, the free allowance is small, and community reports say inbound mail was dropped from the free plan and the allowance was cut over time. Missing for 10: explicit first-party confirmation that the free plan permits sending from a custom domain to arbitrary real recipients (not just sandbox-authorized addresses), clear free-plan feature limits, and current independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo

citations.quote: Send an email in under two minutes using your sandbox domain
We have used Mailgun to power our SaaS emails for years with great deliverability and without paying a cent.
